description.en: Business timestamp. Format: yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS. The time uses Beijing time in 24-hour clock format, accurate to milliseconds.

title.zh: AXB固话隐私号-解绑已有绑定关系
title.en: AXB Fixed-Line Privacy Number - Unbind Existing Bindings

descriptions.zh:
- 解除已有绑定关系的固话AXB隐私号后，可能影响您的业务连续性，请谨慎操作。

- 释放号码前，需解除号码绑定关系。

- 解除固话AXB隐私号绑定关系仅支持此接口的方式进行解除，暂不支持控制台进行解绑。
descriptions.en:
- After unbinding a fixed-line AXB privacy number from an existing binding, your business continuity may be affected. Proceed with caution.

- Before releasing a number, you must unbind the number first.

- Unbinding a fixed-line AXB privacy number is supported only through this API. Unbinding through the console is currently not supported.
